{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Inspect the first few rows
display(penguins.head())

# Check for missing values in body_mass_g
missing_body_mass = penguins['body_mass_g'].isnull().sum()
print(f"Missing body_mass_g: {missing_body_mass}")

# Check the dtype of body_mass_g
print(f"dtype of body_mass_g: {penguins['body_mass_g'].dtype}")

# Check for any extreme outliers in body_mass_g
print(f"Min body_mass_g: {penguins['body_mass_g'].min()}")
print(f"Max body_mass_g: {penguins['body_mass_g'].max()}")

# Check for duplicates
duplicates = penguins.duplicated().sum()
print(f"Number of duplicate rows: {duplicates}")"}
